scopeNote: Downloaded historical examples from 143 matches collected September 29–October 4, 2026. Patch 11308. Opening groups describe a convenience sample, not ladder-wide popularity. Counts and completion times are different measures.

builds.title: French cavalry opening
builds.summary: Follow an observed School of Cavalry opening through its first knight and economy upgrades.

learning.title: The opening
learning.body: School of Cavalry completes at 4:28; the first Royal Knight is recorded at 4:58 in this match.

learning.title: Upgrade timing
learning.body: Wheelbarrow appears at 2:06, Chivalry at 9:28. These are observed completions, not a recommended research queue.

learning.title: Read the count
learning.body: The knight count describes production through 12:00; it does not mean that entire army existed at 4:58.

caveats: Historical convenience sample; not current ladder popularity or a validated executable build.
Villager assignments, resource affordability and research start times are not reconstructed.

validation.timeline: All recorded completion timestamps. Starts are calculated in the app as completion minus installed base duration; worker allocations are calculated from recorded income and per-villager gather rates.
validation.catalogCoverage: All trainable units resolved. Packed Mongol buildings and dropped Japanese banner are object states, not additional units.
validation.resourceSeries: Bank and income directly recorded; spending inferred from provider endpoint checks; per-time gathered derived as bank + spending - starting bank.
validation.armyCounts: Production-minus-loss balances with completed tier upgrades merged into the current tier. Population (including units in training) and army value use installed population and base costs.

builds.title: Mongol stable opening
builds.summary: Study the downloaded stable-led opening and its improved economy technologies.

learning.title: Mobile start
learning.body: The Capital Town Center event at 0:16 is the initial deployment. It is not evidence of a second TC.

learning.title: Economy layers
learning.body: The match records ordinary and improved upgrades separately. Preserve their completion order when comparing effective stats.

learning.title: Team adaptation
learning.body: Use this as a historical 4v4 reference. Scout pressure and ally coverage before copying its economy commitments.

builds.title: Malian cow boom
builds.summary: Explore an observed ranch expansion into Grand Fulani Corral.

learning.title: Build the food economy
learning.body: The first ranch completes at 6:10. Seven ranch constructions are recorded by 9:10; Corral completes at 10:40.

learning.title: Cattle evidence
learning.body: The raw match contains cattle events from 6:34, but they use unknown event code 14. Ranch occupancy and exact passive income cannot be certified from this summary.

learning.title: Investment versus defense
learning.body: Treat ranch expansion as staged commitments. A resource simulation must include cattle purchases, occupancy and the units protecting the economy.

caveats: Historical convenience sample; not current ladder popularity or a validated executable build.
Villager assignments, resource affordability and research start times are not reconstructed.
Cattle event code 14 is unresolved; do not interpret those events as confirmed production or ranch occupancy.

builds.title: French knight mass
builds.summary: Observed French 4v4 with the fastest Royal Knight count in the collection: 12 knights by 10:00 and 24 by 15:00 with 56 villagers.

sources.label: Selection
sources.note: Ranked 38 French rm_4v4 perspectives in the local collection by recorded Royal Knight balance at 15:00 (2026-10-24).

learning.title: Why this reference
learning.body: Among 38 recorded French 4v4 perspectives this one has the highest knight balance at 15:00 (24, versus 17 in the earlier reference) while keeping 56 villagers.

builds.title: Japanese two-TC
builds.summary: Study a verified additional Town Center followed by Castle Age development.

learning.title: A real additional TC
learning.body: The starting capital is recorded at 0:00 and a distinct Town Center type completes at 6:44. This is separate from the later Daimyo upgrade.

learning.title: Two production queues
learning.body: A usable plan needs enough food for both villager queues and its army. The observed timeline alone does not prove that budget.

learning.title: Upgrade choices
learning.body: Open individual upgrade events to see their recorded completion. Compare them with the unit tier and age available at that moment.
